description: This file defines a generic HTTP failure handler class for a web service built with Vert.x. The class, 'DefaultFailureHandler', implements the 'Handler<RoutingContext>' interface to process failed HTTP requests, especially mapping specific exceptions like ServiceInvocationException and HttpStatusException to appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: DefaultFailureHandler
classes.description: A handler for managing failures in Vert.x web routes, converting various exceptions into suitable HTTP error responses.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles routing failures by determining the type of exception and setting appropriate HTTP response codes and messages.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code and error message on the response object, then ends the response.
